theme_strategy: Navy Operational Shell (Premium Dark Mode with Glassmorphism Depth)
executive_mandate: MASCI is ONE operating system. Every page must feel like it was designed by one team on one day. Zero-legacy survivors. No generic white SaaS templates.

headings.rules: No Inter for headings. Use tracking-tight. Maximum text-4xl for page titles (command center style, no landing-page giant heroes).

body.rules: High contrast required (APCA standards). text-sm or text-base for standard density.

labels_and_metrics.rules: Use for numerical data, statuses, and strict operational identifiers.

accents.rule: Portal colors are accents only, never alternate platform themes. Use sparingly for statuses or active indicators.

rules.logo: Exact w-8 h-8. MUST be wrapped in a Link routing strictly to '/' (Shared Operational Home).
rules.glass_treatment: bg-[#0B1221]/70 backdrop-blur-2xl border-b border-white/10. NEVER fully transparent.
rules.portal_label: text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-white/70. Located next to or strictly aligned with the logo.
rules.navigation: Standardized gap-8 spacing. No custom nav spacings per portal.
rules.right_controls: Language selector, Home/Back treatment, and Profile must be identically placed on all 1,190 surfaces.

homepage_command_center.concept: Operational Command Center, answering: Where am I? What can I do? Where should I go next?

rules.hierarchy: Top breadcrumbs/title > Dense action cards > Prioritized routing lists
rules.density: Balanced. Use pure HTML/Tailwind for structural layout, Shadcn components for interactive bits. Every pixel must be utilized efficiently.

glassmorphism.implementation: Background higher opacity (bg-[#131C31]/65), heavy blur (backdrop-blur-xl), 1px delicate inner stroke (border border-white/10), diffuse ambient shadow.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Zero flat white cards. Detail pages, print routes, and portal shells must inherit the Navy glass architecture.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use lucide-react. Standardize stroke-width to 1.5 for a premium, lightweight technical feel.

component_rules.buttons: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded (rounded-md) with subtle gradient borders or distinct hover states. Never inherit generic styles.
component_rules.dialogs_and_modals: Must use the identical surface_glass treatment and border_subtle rules.
component_rules.tables: Dense. No excessive cell padding (use py-2 px-3). Text-sm body. High-contrast headers.
component_rules.forms: Eliminate duplicate controls. Strip explanatory text and replace with smart placeholder/tooltips.

layouts.content_container: max-w-7xl mx-auto p-6 pt-24 (to account for h-16 fixed header + spacing)
layouts.complete_page_rule: When a route is migrated, the ENTIRE surface must be brought to canonical standards simultaneously.

accessibility.contrast: No important operational content may have low contrast. Minimum 4.5:1 for standard text. Never use text-gray-500 on dark backgrounds; use text-slate-400 at minimum.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have a visible focus ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:outline-none).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute. Convention: kebab-case, role-based.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You are writing .js files, NOT .tsx files. Use standard React JSX inside .js.
Never apply `transition: all`. Target specific properties.
Never center-align the app container (`text-align: center`).
Do not use generic emoji characters for icons.
Prioritize HTML/Tailwind for pure structural grid layouts to ensure the Bento dense feel, use Shadcn for standard interactive primitives (select, datepicker).
All headers/overlays must use `backdrop-blur` and a semi-solid background. Transparent backgrounds over content are prohibited.
Autonomous execution: Do not pause for cosmetic approvals. Ensure 100% adherence to the Navy Operational Shell.

image_urls.rule: Images are rarely needed in a data-heavy operational shell. If required for avatars or empty states, ensure they match the premium dark theme.
image_urls.avatars: Use UI faces or pure typographic fallback initials with a navy/glass background.
image_urls.placeholders: Do not use fake placeholder domains. Build semantic HTML fallbacks.
